data.what_is_product:
Tricentis SeaLights is a quality intelligence platform that helps software engineering and QA teams optimize testing coverage, reduce testing cycle times, and maintain confidence in software quality across continuous delivery pipelines. It is a type of test impact analysis and quality analytics solution that helps teams run only the tests that are relevant to recent code changes, eliminating redundant test execution and accelerating release cycles without sacrificing quality assurance.

SeaLights works by instrumenting application code to understand exactly which tests cover which lines of code. When a code change is introduced, SeaLights automatically identifies the minimal set of tests that validate the changed code, skipping tests unrelated to the modification and blocking untested code from reaching production. This approach can reduce testing cycle times by up to 90% while providing stronger assurance that all changed code is covered by at least one test.

Key capabilities include:
- Test impact analytics that automatically selects tests based on code changes across all testing stages
- Code coverage measurement across unit, integration, end-to-end, regression, API, and manual tests
- User story code coverage linking test results to specific engineering requirements
- SAP ABAP change impact analysis with governance controls and real-time quality gates
- Support for multiple programming languages including Java, C/C++, Node.js, .NET, C#, Go, Python, JavaScript, Angular, and React
- Integration with CI/CD pipelines for automated, code-aware quality gates
- Quality governance dashboards providing executive and team-level visibility into coverage trends

SeaLights is designed for enterprise development and QA organizations operating at scale, where full regression test suites have grown too large to run efficiently on every commit. It integrates with Tricentis Testim, qTest, and other tools in the Tricentis ecosystem to bring code-aware intelligence to test selection and quality governance.
data.seller_description: Tricentis is a global leader in enterprise software testing and quality engineering. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Austin, Texas, Tricentis helps more than 3,000 customers — including many of the Global Fortune 500 — deliver software faster, with higher quality and lower risk. The Tricentis platform spans test automation, performance testing, test management, data integrity, quality intelligence, and digital validation across more than 160 enterprise technologies. Tricentis integrates with the tools teams already use, including Jira, Azure DevOps, SAP, Salesforce, Jenkins, and ServiceNow. Tricentis has been recognized as a Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Software Test Automation.

Pricing is based on the number of services or applications instrumented and the volume of code analyzed. Enterprise agreements include support for multiple programming languages, SAP ABAP analysis, CI/CD pipeline integrations, and advanced quality governance dashboards. Contact Tricentis for a custom pricing proposal based on your codebase size and team requirements.
